rules: session_id and patient identity derive from authenticated session, not model arguments
Confirmation, consent changes and memory writes are never model tools
Render recommendation options before returning identical IDs to the voice provider
Provider declarations use only parameters; result schemas and routing metadata are application-owned
Use the same idempotency key for the same normalized tool invocation ID on reconnect/retry
No camera, screenshot, frame, video upload, vision, or surroundings-inspection tool exists in V1.
ElevenLabs client tools must be registered with matching names/parameters and Wait for response enabled; render exact cards before resolving callback.

If native call ID is unavailable to SDK handler, adapter allocates invocation UUID once per callback lifecycle; backend business uniqueness still handles replay/voice-touch races. Do not claim exactly-once native redelivery without a tested stable identity.
